title: SSH: Support OpenSSH strict key exchange extension
description:
Support the OpenSSH strict key exchange extension that resets the
packet sequence number after each SSH2_MSG_NEWKEYS message to
mitigate the "Terrapin Attack."

https://www.openssh.com/txt/release-9.6
https://www.openssh.com/security.html

notes.body:
added 4 commits
  • efc69a9a...d228b913 - 3 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 8379331c - SSH: Support OpenSSH strict key exchange extension
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/19981/diffs?diff_id=1370802080&start_sha=efc69a9a3237f7e37b96f1e1e4f4fb0ca9db0988)
enabled an automatic merge when all merge checks for 8379331c4d0688754917ed595a401d3f134eb364 pass

Thanks John ! 

Running:
```bash
/usr/src/build/openssh-portable/ssh -F none -o KexAlgorithms=mlkem768x25519-sha256 -o Cipher=chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com  nba@10.0.50.77 ls / 2>&1 >/dev/null
```

While capturing show that's all mesages are well decrypted except.

There is still a parsing issue on `msg_code=50` and `msg_code=60 but it's out of scope of this MR
```bash

21	0.237631161	10.0.50.77	10.0.50.78	22	50942	100	SSHv2	Encrypted packet (plaintext_len=84), Public Key algorithm accepted[Malformed Packet]			60
```

commits_data.title: SSH: Support OpenSSH strict key exchange extension
commits_data.message:
SSH: Support OpenSSH strict key exchange extension

Support the OpenSSH strict key exchange extension that resets the
packet sequence number after each SSH2_MSG_NEWKEYS message to
mitigate the "Terrapin Attack."

https://www.openssh.com/txt/release-9.6
https://www.openssh.com/security.html
